title: The Apollo amateur contest that led to the Basie band
summary: At the Apollo amateur contest to find a Basie singer, Humes came second to a girl who sounded like Ella but could not rehearse without records. The band then asked Humes to try, and Basie said he had asked her first.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So then John first had it in his mind to see if he couldn't work it out for you to get with the Basie Band, right?

Right. You know what happened? Let me tell you something that happened. You know, they used to have these amateur contests at the Apollo to try to get singers for the band. And they were having this session this time and I, somebody said, 'hey, go on down there and get on that session'. So I said, "well I don't have any intentions of getting with Basie." So they said, "well just get on down there to the session so people will hear you". And I said, "okay". So I went on down there and I got in this amateur contest and I came second. The girl that won, she sounded just like Ella. So then they said, well, she was the one that was going with Basie. Well when they got her in the studio to rehearse and they didn't have no Ella

So did Basie say anything about the fact that he had already asked you to come with the Band?
Well he told John. He said, " I asked her and she finally got here". I said, "yeah, I finally made it".
